hooks.checkpointCue.refresh: Update checkpoint_context when a finished step or failure changes goals, remaining work or needed evidence.
hooks.checkpointCue.resume: Compaction, resume or fork with no current state in view: inspect_context, then load_context.
hooks.checkpointCue.save: If it corrects, decides, approves, forbids, adds work or changes scope: re-select skills for it, then checkpoint_context.
hooks.checkpointCue.skills: Before answering or the next tool, match this message (questions and check requests included) against the skill targets and call each match before that judgment or action; apply the intake's pre-action checks before building, resuming, reporting or a next step.
hooks.checkpointCue.status: [AGS turn check] {state, select, missing {No prior save: this does not restore what compaction lost.} saved {Work record: present.} other {Work record: none.}}
hooks.environmentFailure.check: [AGS run check] The last tool result shows a missing program, path or permission. Before running it again, read this environment's guide and the script of its last successful run, and set every condition the run needs (paths, temp directory, permissions, options) at once instead of fixing one and re-running to find the next. In the report, say which check was skipped, not only what the environment lacked.
hooks.editGate.denied: [AGS] Product file #{limit, number} changed without a workflow: {paths}{earlier, plural, =0 {} other { (incl. # changed earlier)}}. Start a workflow first (minimal call: {example}).
hooks.editGate.gatedRoot: [AGS] {path} is in the write scope of workflow root {rootId} ({state}), which awaits a decision, so it cannot be changed. Change it after that root is decided with resolve_convergence_gate, and keep working on parts that do not overlap.
hooks.editGate.outsideScope: [AGS] Product file #{limit, number} changed outside the running workflows' writeTargets: {paths}{earlier, plural, =0 {} other { (incl. # changed earlier outside them)}}. If this is separate work, start another workflow with non-overlapping writeTargets; a session can run several at once (minimal call: {example}).
hooks.phaseCheck.continue: If the goal is unmet, keep working, even after finishing the request just received. Record a stage result only after its work and verification are actually done, and do not stop at recording.
hooks.phaseCheck.pending: [AGS stage check] Workflow runId {runId} (rootId {rootId}) has stages not yet passed: {stages}. Check with get_workflow_status (runId) or get_convergence_status (rootId).
hooks.phaseCheck.startFailed: [AGS] A workflow start failed in this window. Cause codes: {codes}. The edit gate judged edits as usual.
hooks.phaseCheck.unavailable: [AGS] The workflow state could not be checked, so product file changes in this window were not blocked. Cause codes: {codes}.
hooks.phaseCheck.waiting: If only the user's answer or approval lets you proceed, state in one line what you wait for and stop. Drop unneeded stages by revising the plan.
hooks.skillTrigger.invocation: Claude Code: invoke chosen installed skills with the Skill tool or /agent-governance-suite:<skill-name>.
hooks.subagentCue.scope: Stay within your brief's goal, scope, forbidden areas and write ownership. For a change outside it, an approval it does not give, or another owner's files, do not widen or work around it: state the need in your result and return it to the agent that delegated to you. Do not pass your whole assignment unchanged to one other agent.
hooks.contextLayers.cleared: [AGS {layer, select, global {global} other {role (role={role})}} context was cleared] The body you received earlier no longer applies.
hooks.contextLayers.roleBound:
[AGS assigned role role={role}{changed, select, yes { · changed during this session} other {}}]
The role the user gave this session on the admin page; its shared role context has no body yet. When the role's work yields a decision or criterion later sessions need, read the latest with load_shared_context and save it with checkpoint_role_context.
hooks.contextLayers.roleSaveCue: [AGS role save role={role}] {state, select, empty {The shared context of this role is still empty. If this session holds decisions, criteria or owned areas later sessions of the role need, save them this turn with checkpoint_role_context (expectedStateToken null).} other {If this turn yields a decision or criterion later sessions of this role need, rebuild the whole body from load_shared_context and save it with checkpoint_role_context.}}
hooks.contextLayers.jevCue: [AGS skill advice] JEV is ready: before choosing skills for work in this turn, pass the actual work and the full inventory (get_skill_inventory) to classify_skills. Questions and one-line edits skip it. It is advice only: adopt, correct or reject it, and if the call fails choose yourself and continue.
hooks.contextLayers.roleUnbound: [AGS role binding removed · previous role={role}] This session no longer holds that role. The role and role context you received earlier no longer apply.
hooks.contextLayers.verifyFailed: [AGS verification failed · {layer, select, global {global context} keys {passkey list} roles {role registry} binding {this session's role binding} jev {JEV settings} jevKeys {JEV keys} locale {display language} editExempt {edit gate exceptions} other {admin record}} · {revision, select, none {no valid revision, default in use} other {r{revision} in use}} · tell the user · agents cannot fix this] A change whose signed record failed its check ({reason}) was not applied. The user checks it on the admin page {adminUrl}.
hooks.contextLayers.unreadable: [AGS shared context unreadable · {layer, select, role {role context} other {signed record}} · tell the user · agents cannot fix this] That layer is not given this time.
